newsitem.title: USA: Verifone falls after lower-than-expected Q3.
newsitem.headline: Verifone falls after lower-than-expected Q3.

text.p: Shares of VeriFone Inc fell 8-5/8 to 32-1/4, losing 20 percent of their value, after the company reported third quarter earnings that were off by $0.02 a share from Wall Street expectations.
Verifone posted earnings of $0.42 a share for the quarter, up from $0.38 a share a year ago.
Wall Street's mean estimate was $0.44 a share, according to a First Call tally. The range of estimates submitted by seven analysts was $0.44 to $0.45.
Although VeriFone's revenues grew 17.7 percent, it's gross margins fell to 45.5 percent in the quarter from 46.7 percent in the second quarter and 47.4 percent in the year ago third quarter.
On the plus side, operating expenses fell as a percentage of revenues by 3.6 percent from a year ago.
The electronic payment systems maker spoke of "gross margin pressure" during the quarter in its earnings statement, but said it worked to control expenses to offset that pressure.
